title: .jgates/profiles.yml
description: The project's profiles: which checks run and how deep. enabled: false turns a check off; null is invalid; absent inherits.

tier.description: How far the profile's capability, category and component entries reach (ADR-0022): core (the tools JGates always had), main (also the main tool of each language and format) or extended (every tool). A tool above the tier is off with its reason until a tool:<id> entry switches it on. Absent: inherited from extends; core when no profile of the chain says one.

gates.description: The gates this profile selects: quality, semantic or both (Quality always runs first).

when.description: available: with enabled: true, the check runs where an applicable, executable tool for it exists; where none does, the plan reports it as not applicable (with the reason) and does not block. Absent: an enabled check is required (fail-closed).
